commands.review_summary:
The PR preserves accumulated OpenResponses text for empty replacement events carrying media fields and adds an HTTP/SSE regression test.

PR surface: Source +7, Tests +41. Total +48 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source and harness level: streamed text followed by an empty replacement clears the accumulator on current main. The natural integrated producer path has not yet been demonstrated.

target.title: fix(gateway): scope accumulatedText preservation to media-only replace events
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where multimodal agent users on the OpenResponses gateway would see their assistant reply silently replaced with "No response from OpenClaw." when the upstream provider emitted a media-only SSE replace event (`replace: true`, `text: ""`) during streaming.

## Why This Change Was Made

The old guard `typeof text === "string"` treated empty string as valid content, unconditionally resetting `accumulatedText` on any `replace: true` event. This is incorrect when the agent runtime delivers a media attachment after text has been streamed — the runtime produces a `replace: true, text: ""` event that carries `mediaUrls` or `mediaUrl` but should not erase previously streamed assistant text.

The fix scopes accumulated-text preservation to **media-bearing** replacement events by checking `mediaUrls`/`mediaUrl` — the same media-content signal used by the existing SSE coalesce path (`server-chat.ts:1101`). A `replace: true, text: ""` event without a media signal continues to clear the buffer per existing behavior.

## User Impact

Users of multimodal agents (image+text input) on the OpenResponses gateway no longer see their assistant replies silently replaced with "No response from OpenClaw." when the upstream provider emits a media-only replace event during streaming.

## Evidence

**Shipped code alignment.** The agent runtime producer (`agent-runner-execution.ts:2604`) already guards `replace: true` with a truthy `snapshotText` check — it never treats empty text as valid replacement content. The chat SSE path (`server-chat.ts:1101`) already identifies media-only events via `mediaUrls.length > 0`. This fix extends the same pattern to the OpenResponses path.

**Real SSE event stream.** Local gateway instance with the fix applied, sending a real HTTP request through `/v1/responses` with a media-only replace event injected after two text deltas:

```
=== SSE Event Stream ===
  [SSE] response.created
  [SSE] response.in_progress
  [SSE] response.output_item.added
  [SSE] response.content_part.added
  [SSE] response.output_text.delta → delta: "Hello "
  [SSE] response.output_text.delta → delta: "world"
  [SSE] response.output_text.done
  [SSE] response.content_part.done
  [SSE] response.output_item.done
  [SSE] response.completed → output text: "Hello world"
  [SSE] DONE

=== Verification ===
  Deltas combined:        "Hello world"
  Completed output text:  "Hello world"

  ✅ PASS: Accumulated text PRESERVED after media-only replace event.
```

**Integration test.** All three gateway configurations pass:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/gateway/openresponses-http.test.ts -t "preserves accumulated text on media-only replace"
```

```
 ✓ |gateway-core|  preserves accumulated text on media-only replace:true with empty text
 ✓ |gateway-server| preserves accumulated text on media-only replace:true with empty text
 ✓ |gateway-client| preserves accumulated text on media-only replace:true with empty text
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

**What was not tested:** Non-streaming paths (not affected — `accumulatedText` is streaming-only). Non-media empty-text replacement semantics (no known producer emits such events, and the existing shipped agent-runner guard already skips them).
